entities.summary: Somalia is a sovereign nation in East Africa, Africa. Its capital is Mogadishu. Official languages include Somali, Arabic. Government: Federal parliamentary republic (fragile state). Population: approximately 18.1 million. Area: 637,657 km². Comprehensive index for Somalia covering Land of Punt, Mogadishu Sultanate, Ajuran Empire, Scramble for Africa (British/Italian/French Somaliland), Siad Barre, civil war and state collapse, piracy, Al-Shabaab, and Somaliland.
